description: This file defines the OrderProductEntity class, which extends OrderProduct and implements Serializable. It adds properties such as orderedQuantity and product, along with respective getters and setters.

classes.name: OrderProductEntity
classes.description: A Java class representing an order product entity with additional fields for quantity and product details, used in a sales/order processing context.

methods.name: setOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: getOrderedQuantity
methods.description: Returns the quantity of the product ordered.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the product details associated with this order.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the product details associated with this order.
